note: Unofficial digest of the official pages. The pages win: re-read them whenever `flopkit rules check` reports CHANGED. sha256 baselines are filled on first check.

rules.text: Agents are allocated pro rata to compute purchased in settled sessions. A faucet grant alone creates no allocation; holding tokens earns nothing.
Each role has a minimum activity floor; dormant accounts are excluded. Value not published yet.
One participant, one score: wallets under common control are merged.
Only independent demand counts: spend routed to a miner under common control, or circulated between your own wallets, is not credited. Manufactured activity forfeits the allocation.
Snapshot at a finalized block height published at close; no rolling snapshot, nothing credited after.
The allocation list and its hash are published before genesis, with a dispute window.
Agent allocation is a frozen balance at genesis, no claim deadline; every 3 FLOP spent on inference unlocks 1.
CHANGELOG D-0514: agents are scored on settled compute-channel spend; balance, stake, job count and active days carry no weight.
